Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Australia Women are in a huddle where Alyssa Healy is giving them a pep talk. Now, they spread out to take their respective field positions. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the two openers for India Women. Kim Garth start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... FOURTH INNINGS ...

Australia Women on the other hand will be extremely disappointed by the way they played this morning with a lack of intent. Tahlia McGrath and Ellyse Perry's partnership was crucial in getting Australia closer to the Indian first-inning total along with smaller starts from Allysa Healy and Annabel Sutherland which got them to a total of 261 runs. Australia will have to do the unthinkable to get this match back in their favour. Will Australia Women pull out a rabbit off their hat? Or will India Women chase this total down comfortably to create history? Stay tuned for the final innings coming your way shortly.

India Women will go to bat in the 4th innings with momentum after a power-packed bowling effort to knock off all the Australian batters within the first hour of the game on Day 4.Sneh Rana and Pooja Vastrakar started the day exceptionally well bowling on tight lines and lengths, creating numerous close chances and claiming 2 crucial wickets to expose the tail of the Australian batting line-up. Sneh Rana was the pick of the bowler for her four-fer supported well by all the other bowlers. India Women will now have to go out and express themselves freely chasing down this small target without worrying about how the track would play.
That's the end of the innings for Australia on Day 4, as they get bundled up for 261 runs at the end of 105.4 overs giving India Women a target of just 75 runs to create history.

Australia Women scored at just 2.1 runs per over when the spinners came on to bowl in the third innings and were playing from the crease and not moving their feet. They conclude that both teams will have to use their feet and negate the spin to make batting a bit easier.

Ellyse Perry is up for a chat. She says Day 3 was their best Day in this Test, which has set this game up nicely with all three possible results. Praises Tahlia McGrath for her batting and tells that she used her feet nicely and looked to hit straight whenever possible. Mentions that their plan was to stick to their individual batting plans and they are not really big sweepers so that was that. Ends by saying it is going to be a great challenge.

Australia Women batted exceptionally well adapting to the surface and conditions better than they had done in their first inning. After a couple of wickets went down, Ellyse Perry and Tahlia McGrath steadied the ship and kept scoring at a healthy rate. Australia would be slightly disappointed that they lost 5 wickets by the end of Day's play which has slightly put them on the back foot. Nevertheless, they would want to come out to bat with positive intent and a desire to get a favourable result. The first session of this Day will be crucial to both teams, at the end of which, we will probably know where this Test match will head! Stay tuned and expect some thrilling action coming your way on the Final Day of this exciting Test match.

Team India will be pleased by their effort with the ball on Day 3, claiming 5 wickets. Sneh Rana broke the crucial partnership between Ellyse Perry and Tahlia McGrath that looked dangerous followed by Harmanpreet Kaur knocking off 2 important wickets. All the other bowlers did well to ensure no starts by the Australian batters went big! Team India will now be aiming at bundling out the Australian team quickly and then chasing down whatever is in front of them to create history.

India Women, on the other hand, would have liked a few more runs but they ended up with a 183-run first-innings lead with Pooja Vastrakar and Deepti Sharma missing out on a half-century and a hundred respectively. After coming onto bowl, their pacers were not that effective and conceded a few too many easy runs. However, they were given an opportunity where Richa Ghosh showed good presence of mind in the field to get them the crucial breakthrough while Sneh Rana followed it up with an important wicket as well. Things could have been even better if Richa Ghosh was able to hold onto a difficult chance but overall they will be happy going into Lunch. They will look to make early inroads in the second session and put more pressure on the visitors. Join us at 12.10 pm IST (6.40 am GMT) to see how the post-Lunch session pans out.

SESSION SUMMARY - 93 runs and 5 wickets in 24.3 overs! A shared session as both teams had their moments! Australia Women came up with the short-ball plan to start Day 3 and stuck to that which got them the rewards as they were able to bowl the hosts out inside the first hour. They stopped the hosts from taking a lead over 200 runs and their openers looked on song as well after coming onto bat. They added 49 runs together before a brain-fade moment from Beth Mooney cost her the wicket while Phoebe Litchfield followed suit with a poor shot selection. Ellyse Perry and Tahlia McGrath managed to see it out till Lunch and will look to build this partnership in the second session to reduce the lead and get closer to it.
